correctness.rationale: The norm formula exactly describes the source hexagon. For \(\delta=\varepsilon/(2-\varepsilon)\), the two extreme norming functionals at \(x\) have distance \(\varepsilon\). Their zero values on \(R_+\) and \(R_-\) certify the two Birkhoff--James orthogonalities. The branchwise choice of \(s\) gives \(\|y_1+y_2\|=2s\), while the two endpoint functional values on the sum are \(s\varepsilon\) and \(\varepsilon\), so convexity of \(J(x)\) makes the least approximate-orthogonality parameter exactly \(\varepsilon/2\).
